answers.goal: For me the ULTIMATE goal would be to be on the leading front of film and entertainment back home in the DR. Would love to represent Latino talent and then create back home.
answers.drew: I want to be in the entertainment industry because I believe stories have the power to influence culture, inspire people, and create shared experiences. I’m drawn to the intersection of creativity and business, where talent, strategy, and relationships come together to bring ideas to life. I want to be part of the teams that discover, develop, and deliver the next generation of entertainment.
answers.seeking: Just people who are passionate about the future of entertainment. Lot of people talk about how entertainment is going down, but I reject this theory!
answers.inspiration: My grandfather, who taught me the value of work ethic and purpose.
